regime.Uptrend: Bitcoin is above its 200-day average and its 50-day average is rising.
regime.Range: Bitcoin's price and its 50-day average are not pointing the same way, so there is no clear trend.
regime.Downtrend: Bitcoin is below its 200-day average and its 50-day average is falling.

fuel.Rising: Money available to flow into crypto is growing, judged by stablecoin supply, global money supply, the dollar and, when connected, ETF flows.
fuel.Flat: Money available to flow into crypto is little changed, judged by stablecoin supply, global money supply, the dollar and, when connected, ETF flows.
fuel.Falling: Money available to flow into crypto is shrinking, judged by stablecoin supply, global money supply, the dollar and, when connected, ETF flows.

fragility.Low: Few traders are borrowing heavily and sentiment is not at an extreme, so sharp drops are less likely than usual.
fragility.Elevated: Borrowing or sentiment is above normal, so sharp drops are somewhat more likely than usual.
fragility.High: Many traders are borrowing heavily or sentiment is at an extreme, so sharp drops are more likely than usual.

levels.noSupport: no support zone found below the price.
levels.resistanceNone: No resistance zone found above the price.
levels.unavailable: Levels to watch: not available yet.

history.ready: In similar conditions Bitcoin was higher 90 days later in {higher}% of cases, but fell more than 20% along the way in {fell}%. Based on {n} independent periods.
history.thinNote: Thin history: fewer than {min} independent periods, so read these rates with care.

D1.name: Spot ETF flows, 20-day sum
D1.tells: Institutional money coming in or going out.

states.inflow: Money is flowing into Bitcoin ETFs.
states.outflow: Money is flowing out of Bitcoin ETFs.
states.flat: Money going into and out of Bitcoin ETFs is about even.
states.unavailable: ETF flow data is not connected yet, so Fuel is read without it.

states.early: Fewer than {from} months since the last halving.
states.inWindow: Between {from} and {to} months since the last halving, the stretch in which past peaks came.
states.late: More than {to} months since the last halving, past the stretch in which past peaks came.
states.unavailable: The halving-cycle position is not available.

D3.name: Sentiment extremes
D3.tells: Fear & Greed above 80 or below 20. Extreme greed has often come near tops, extreme fear near bottoms.

states.extremeGreed: Fear & Greed is in extreme greed, which has often come near tops.
states.extremeFear: Fear & Greed is in extreme fear, which has often come near bottoms.
states.neutral: Fear & Greed is not at an extreme.
states.unavailable: Fear & Greed data is not available.

D4.name: Liquidation clusters
D4.tells: Prices where many leveraged bets get force-closed.

states.near: A liquidation cluster sits close to the price, and price is often pulled toward these.
states.far: No liquidation cluster sits close to the price.
states.unavailable: Liquidation data is not connected yet, so Fragility is read without it.

D5.name: Long-term holder behaviour
D5.tells: Old coins moving to exchanges near tops, accumulation in fear.

states.distributing: Long-term holders are moving coins to exchanges.
states.neutral: Long-term holders show no clear change.

scenarios.unavailable: Key levels are not available, so there is no trigger to show.

base.title: Base case
base.none: {lead}, but no nearby levels are available to bound it.
base.triggerNone: No trigger: key levels are not available.

upside.title: Upside
upside.summary: A move higher opens the next resistance.
upside.trigger: A daily close above {zone} ({strength}) opens the next resistance, {next}.
upside.triggerNoNext: A daily close above {zone} ({strength}) leaves no further resistance zone mapped.
upside.triggerWeakOnly: No Medium or Strong resistance zone above; the nearest zone is {zone} ({strength}).
upside.triggerNone: No resistance zone found above the price.

downside.title: Downside
downside.summary: A move lower opens the next support.
downside.trigger: A daily close below {zone} ({strength}) opens the next support, {next}.
downside.triggerNoNext: A daily close below {zone} ({strength}) leaves no further support zone mapped.
downside.triggerNone: No support zone found below the price.
